variants.label: 정돈된 베벨 금속
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: small combat tab game icon for RuneNexus dark fantasy mobile UI. Create ONE standalone SHIELD icon only on a genuinely transparent alpha background. Theme reference: dark gunmetal and bright silver steel edges, cyan accent, premium restrained dark fantasy UI. Full frontal view centered, no perspective tilt; isolated shield occupies roughly 80 percent of square canvas. Strong coarse silhouette and broad contrasting planes so it remains recognizable at 20 to 24 pixels. Painterly polished game asset, refined dimensional metal shading, not a photograph. Uniform soft upper-left light, no cast shadow outside object. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no square frame, no socket, no card, no button, no pedestal, no weapon, no swords, no hands, no character, no additional objects. No glow halo, no rays, no particles, no background, no checkerboard pattern. Cyan is a small restrained inset or engraving, not an overpowering glow. Keep midtones and bright steel edges sufficiently luminous against dark navy game UI. Preserve shield meaning.
Variant design: Classic beveled steel shield, crisp symmetric pentagonal silhouette, thick bright silver steel rim around a dark gunmetal face, one tiny cyan inset near the center, large clean planes.
